kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element of the inhomogeneous extension A = V + C K + C kappa; carries the deformation (Schema 2). Not a basis element of g; first in PBW order.

K.label: K
K.relation: [K, X} = 0 for all X; identified with the scalar 1
K.role: even central element (constant term of oscillator words). Excluded from basis lists; appears as a bracket target label only in Schemas 2-4 when a constant term arises.

f_parameterization.description: odd linear map f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_ij Z_i; unknown phi[<Z_i>][<Z_j>] is the coefficient of Z_i in f(Z_j); only parity-reversing pairs are unknowns
f_parameterization.target: g + C K (K allowed as a target only for odd sources; f(K) = 0)

coboundary_symbolic_convention.pairs: ordered pairs (X,Y) with index(X) <= index(Y) in pbw_order; the rest follow by super-antisymmetry

coboundary_symbolic.expr: phi[E_eps1_del3_pp][H_1] - phi[E_eps1_del3_pp][H_2] - phi[E_eps1_del3_pp][H_3] + 2*phi[E_eps1_del3_pp][H_4] + phi[H_1][E_eps1_del3_mm] - phi[H_3][E_eps1_del3_mm] - phi[H_4][E_eps1_del3_mm]
phi[E_eps1_del3_mm][H_1] - phi[E_eps1_del3_mm][H_2] - phi[E_eps1_del3_mm][H_3] + 2*phi[E_eps1_del3_mm][H_4] - phi[H_1][E_eps1_del3_pp] + phi[H_3][E_eps1_del3_pp] + phi[H_4][E_eps1_del3_pp]

representative_f.description: f = -l where X(a') = X(a) + kappa l(X) under the oscillator change of variables a_1^s -> a_1^s + sum_{j,t} d_{s,j,t} b_j^t kappa with d_{s,j,+} = gb_{s,j,-}, d_{s,j,-} = -gb_{s,j,+} (which undoes the deformed relation [b_j^t, a_1^s] = -gb kappa). Targets include K for odd sources.

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras, arXiv:hep-th/9607161
